main.description: Create a gate (hide clip) on behalf of a streamer. Requires 'clip.hide' permission. Creates a place.stream.clip.gate record in the streamer's repository.

clipUri.description: The AT-URI of the place.stream.clip.entry record to hide.

clipCid.description: The CID of the place.stream.clip.entry record to hide.

uri.description: The AT-URI of the created gate record.

cid.description: The CID of the created gate record.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: The request lacks valid authentication credentials.
